_comment: Provenance sidecar for creality_flash.py and creality_validator.py, copied verbatim from NebulaOS-klipper-mcu/tools/. Added in Phase 1.8B live hardware qualification after Gate 1 discovered these files were never deployed to /opt/nebulaos/tools/ (the default CREALITY_FLASH_PATH mcu_lifecycle.py/mcu_restore.py import from) - the guard crashed with ModuleNotFoundError on the very first real boot, before ever classifying the MCU or attempting a restore. All prior offline tests passed because mcu_lifecycle.decide()/mcu_restore.restore() always received an injected mock creality_flash_module in tests/mcu-lifecycle-decision-tests.py, so the real dynamic `import creality_flash` fallback branch was never exercised until live hardware.
runtime_dependency: pyserial (confirmed present on-device Python3, /usr/lib/python3.11/site-packages/serial); imported lazily only inside creality_flash.SerialTransport.__init__, not at module import time
